title: Fourteen Days to Find Sh1.1 Billion: Keroche Takes On the Taxman
conflicts: Demand amount: Sh1.1 billion (KRA's own figures, Business Daily 2017, 2008 law blog, How we made it in Africa 2015) vs Sh1.2 billion (Keroche CEO's 2020 op-ed); story uses about Sh1.1 billion. Backdating: nine years vs five years vs 2002-2005; story says 'back to 2002'. Old rate 45% (op-ed, law blog) vs 40% (Business Daily); story uses 45%. Court of Appeal 2017: KRA says it won and the 2007 decision was set aside; Business Daily reported a win for Keroche; story gives both and the shared point (fresh assessments with proper notice). Founding 1997 (HBS, CNN) vs 1992 (How we made it in Africa 2014); story uses 1997. The closure threat comes from one source only and is attributed.
notes: Arc changed from hard-responsibility to setback: Keroche won the 2007 judicial review but lost its fortified-wine line (about 80% of revenue) to the 2007-08 tax changes and pivoted to ready-to-drink vodka and Summit lager. Kenya Law's judgment page is behind a bot challenge, so the holdings come from Business Daily, KRA and a 2008 law blog. Quote complicates the decision to litigate.
